cases.prompt: A Go service retries three times at four RPC layers and melts the leaf dependency during a 2% error spike.
cases.reason: The task is retry amplification and overload control.

cases.prompt: Allocate a 700 ms request budget across queueing and two possible outbound Go HTTP attempts.
cases.reason: The task requires end-to-end deadline and attempt budgeting.

cases.prompt: Retry parsing a local configuration file after a syntax error.
cases.reason: This is a permanent local input failure, not a remote partial-failure path.

cases.prompt: Choose when to ack a queue message so a crash cannot lose the database update.
cases.reason: Broker delivery semantics belong to go-message-processing.

cases.prompt: Every service in a five-hop Go call chain retries three times. Improve resilience without removing all retries.
criteria: Assigns one retry owner with bounded attempt and elapsed budgets.
Combines retry policy with dependency capacity and admission control.
anti_criteria: Only adds exponential backoff at every layer.
Retries permanent or ambiguous non-idempotent failures.

cases.prompt: A dependency has no timeouts and callers queue without limit. Should we add a circuit breaker first?
criteria: Prioritizes deadline, admission, and bounded retry fundamentals.
Explains the additional state and recovery risks of a circuit breaker.
Keeps a breaker conditional on evidence that simpler controls are insufficient.
anti_criteria: Adds a circuit breaker as a universal first step.
Leaves the unbounded queue in place.
